Lead PM — Embedded Insurance, London hybrid.

Harrow Cover is a fintech building embedded insurance products for SME marketplaces; we're funded through a recent round, though we're still working out which distribution channel wins, so trajectory is genuinely unclear right now. We're hiring a Lead PM to own actuarial pricing model design — you'll work daily with our actuaries to build risk-adjusted premium curves, reserve modelling, and regulatory capital calculations. This is a deeply technical insurance-pricing role: prior experience with actuarial methods, loss ratios, and insurance underwriting mathematics is essential, not just useful. Hybrid, two days a week from our London office.
